## About
Precision Auto Body has been family owned and operated from day one. The shop got its start in Hollywood, where it was the only body shop for Hollywood Sports Car and Mercedes-Benz of North America, and later moved to the San Fernando Valley. Today we're on Tampa Ave in Reseda.
We use factory parts whenever possible and own the factory approved equipment needed to bring your car back to the manufacturer's specifications. High-end cars are our specialty, but we work on all makes and models.
We care about the environment too. We were one of the first shops in California to use a water-based paint system, we run on Sun Power solar panels, and color-correct LED lighting throughout the shop gives us a more natural light to work in. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating across 284 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Accident repair for drivers in Reseda and across the San Fernando Valley.
- Remanufactured to factory specs on Celette jigs: Cars are brought back to factory specs on Celette jigs, as manufacturer certification requires.
- Water-based paint: Refinishing with a water-based paint system, something we adopted early.
- Virtual photo estimate: Start your estimate by sending photos of the damage before you come in.
- Help with insurance claims: We work with all insurance companies and help move your collision claim along.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on luxury cars?
A: No. High-end cars are our specialty, but we work on all makes and models.

Q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
A: We work well with all insurance companies and can help expedite your collision claim.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We use factory parts whenever possible.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: You can start a virtual photo estimate online, or call to schedule an appointment for an estimate or to drop off your car.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we're closed on Saturday and Sunday.
